name: MCP OpenAPI Projection Tools
description: Add table-scoped MCP tools that let clients retrieve OpenAPI 3.2 projection artifacts for component-bundle and operation-contract profiles, together with validateOpenApiProjection() results.

userStories.title: Define table-scoped MCP projection tool contract
userStories.description: As an MCP client developer, I want a table-scoped tool contract for OpenAPI projection export so that AI tools can discover table schema projections directly through MCP.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a table-scoped MCP tool named get-openapi-projection-{tableId} or equivalent.
Tool description states that it returns an OpenAPI 3.2 projection artifact for the current table.
Tool input schema supports profile.
profile supports component-bundle and operation-contract.
Default profile is component-bundle.
Tool input schema uses enum constraints for supported profile values.
Tool output contract is documented in code comments or docs.
Existing table-scoped MCP tools remain listed.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused MCP/projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Tool contract only. Prefer table-scoped server because table context is already fixed there.

userStories.title: Register projection export tool in Table MCP Server
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want table-scoped tools/list to include the projection export tool so that I know the projection is available.
acceptanceCriteria: TableMcpServer registers the projection export tool during table tool initialization.
The tool appears in tools/list for table-scoped MCP servers.
The tool does not require TableSchemaProjectionService during list-time schema construction.
Missing projection service is represented in handler output, not by omitting the tool.
Focused tools/list test verifies the tool name, description, input schema, and profile enum.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused MCP/projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Depends on the tool contract shape.

userStories.title: Implement MCP projection export handler
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want to call the projection export tool so that I can retrieve the table OpenAPI projection from MCP.
acceptanceCriteria: Handler obtains the current table projection through TableSchemaProjectionService.
For component-bundle, handler returns toTableSchemaOpenApiProjectionResult(projection).
For operation-contract, handler returns toTableSchemaOpenApiOperationContractProjectionResult(projection).
Handler calls validateOpenApiProjection() on the projection result.
Handler returns { projection, validation }.
Returned projection includes profile, projection, refs, diagnostics, sources, versionHash, and typeTargets where available.
Returned projection document includes root-level x-schema-engine-* extension fields.
Unsupported profile values return a structured MCP error.
Missing projection service returns a structured MCP error.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused MCP/projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Use existing projection adapters and validator. Do not create MCP-only projection logic.
